description: Public-domain courses by PlayfulProcess. MDX files served via raw.githubusercontent.com — no build step required.

courses.title: Build a Tarot Deck with Claude Code
courses.description: Work the way the Recursive Tarot was built: clone the public repo, use Claude Code to turn a public-domain deck into a grammar, source images from Wikimedia Commons, preview it locally, and push it back so anyone can play it in recursive.eco.
courses.author: PlayfulProcess
courses.audience: Anyone with a deck they love and no prior coding experience
